stem.text: A section of an addition polymer is shown.

stem.alt: Displayed section of an addition polymer: a chain of carbon atoms drawn with vertical C–H and C–O bonds, with ethanoyloxy (OCOCH3) groups attached to some of the chain carbons, above and below the chain.

stem.text: Which monomer is used to make this polymer?

D.alt: Skeletal formula: CH2=C(OC(=O)CH3)2, a central carbon double-bonded to CH2 and bearing two ethanoyloxy groups.
